name: Summer Paradise Redux
source:
You play as a teenage girl who is returning to her hometown for a summer vacation after 9 long years. She rekindled old friendships and makes new ones. Her grandmother tells her that she has to find a date for the upcoming town festival or else she will be paired with a guy she doesn't know! Will you manage to find the right guy or will you be forced to partner up with a stranger?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43374&sid=cbfc413c5822ab2b027f3a11779ecefd]LemmaSoft[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名少女。离开故乡整整9年后，她在暑假回到家乡，重拾旧日友谊，也结识新朋友。祖母告诉她，必须为即将到来的城镇祭典找一位约会对象，否则就会被安排和一个不认识的男孩搭档！你能找到合适的男孩吗？还是会被迫和陌生人组队？

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43374&sid=cbfc413c5822ab2b027f3a11779ecefd]Lemma Soft[/url]]
